description: RESOLVED 2026-09-16 as a documented, required codegen artifact: probed every named form under the TU's GNU assembler (decomp_probe.py vs the 80-byte reference). A plain small-data extern emits single-instruction GPREL16 load/store (72 B, mismatch). A .data-section extern emits a two-register absolute load (lui $9; lw $6,%lo($9)) plus a reallocated body (mismatch). A .data + -mno-split-addresses extern reproduces the self-based count access but reschedules the body (store order swapped, the daddu moves dropped, 64 B vs 80 B, mismatch). The plain named extern DOES match 80/80 under the SN assembler: ps2eeas expands the GPREL macro in place to a self-based absolute lui/lw pair because EGC emits the .extern declaration at the end of the file. But migrating draw.o to SN is not viable: a full SN build of the TU makes draw_resetTextureDmaState 48 B under ps2eeas vs the original's 60 B under GNU as (GNU as emits three NOPs in the `.set noreorder/nomacro` + bgez loop pattern that ps2eeas omits), and that single 12-byte delta shifts the whole TU 0x10 early from 0x1F0BC8 on (full build cmp fails at byte 0xA1265; tu_assembler_diff shows 84/84 function diffs). The constant-address cast is therefore retained, and the in-source comment now documents why. drawCallbackCount stays in symbols.txt for the sibling generated assembly; the wider counter family (0x15F464/68/6C/70/74, zeroed by ResetDrawGlobals, used by the add/call-all functions at 0x1F4650-0x1F4858) is left unnamed pending its own nonmatching investigation. Change is comment-only; full clean build + cmp pass.
